claim: arch_diff_command.md's Responsibilities section says DiffCommand must "Run the lifecycle pre-flight ([[a9aa93774cc2|ProjectResolver]]) to obtain the project context" and its Interface section says absence is surfaced as "the pre-flight's uninitialised-or-broken refusal"; test_merkle_commands.md's E7 fixture is literally "no .spex/ state directory". But ProjectResolver (lifecycle module, a9aa93774cc2) and InitCommand — the component that creates .spex/ — are separate beads (spexmachina-uiei.8, spexmachina-uiei.10) that have not run yet, and the beads graph places them AFTER this one (spexmachina-uiei.4 blocks spexmachina-uiei.8, not the reverse), so no lifecycle package, ProjectResolver type, or .spex/ directory convention exists anywhere in the code for this bead to call or point at.
authoritative_source: The proposal spec/proposals/2026-08-20-project-lifecycle.md, "Path resolution and a compatibility window" addendum: "Migration is a constraint on landing order, not a feature. This repository's own state files (spec/.snapshot.json, spec/.history.jsonl, ...) move in the same PR that lands the no-fallback resolver: any main commit where the new binary exists but the files have not moved is self-broken." And absorb.json's entries for cb262b280963/dfe1467b7a4b/35f39388bc76 explicitly say the .spex/ resolution behaviour is "owed in full by the SnapshotStore, DiffCommand and InitCommand beads" jointly — i.e. by design this is a multi-bead migration, not something any single one of the three (including this one) can complete alone without InitCommand existing to create .spex/ and without a coordinated repo-wide file move.
evidence: Grepping the whole Go tree for ".spex" and "ProjectResolver" before this change returns zero hits outside spec/ markdown — there is no lifecycle package to call. Switching DiffCommand's default resolution to require .spex/ right now, in isolation, would make `spex diff` refuse to run against this very repository (spec/.snapshot.json exists, .spex/ does not) — exactly the "self-broken main commit" the proposal's addendum warns against, and it would break this project's own self-hosting spex pipeline (CLAUDE.md: "Self-hosting: Spex Machina's own spec is managed by Spex Machina") before InitCommand/the repo migration bead ever lands. Building ProjectResolver myself to avoid that would also exceed this bead's component scope (CONTEXT.md names only the merkle module's leaves) and pre-empt spexmachina-uiei.8's own job.
proposed_fix: This PR implements the behavioural core of the change now (SnapshotStore.Load's no-fallback contract propagated into DiffCommand: no stat-and-fallback, absence at the resolved default location is refused with a stable not-a-spex-project exit code distinct from 1 and 2, a corrupt snapshot is a broken-project exit 1 naming 'spex doctor') using the CURRENT default location (<spec-dir>/.snapshot.json) as an interim stand-in for the .spex/-resolved location, since that is the only location InitCommand can seed until it exists. When spexmachina-uiei.8 (ProjectResolver) and spexmachina-uiei.10 (InitCommand) land, that work should (a) build the real ProjectResolver in the lifecycle module, (b) migrate this repository's own spec/.snapshot.json, spec/.history.jsonl and absorb.json into .spex/ in the same PR as the addendum requires, and (c) replace DiffCommand's inlined pre-flight (cmd/spex/diff.go's exitNotAProject block) with a call to the real ProjectResolver, deleting the interim constant/comment that names this bead.
